fact: Telma (AXIAN Telecom) stated on 10 February 2023 that the 2Africa cable, which interconnects 33 countries in Africa, Europe and the Middle East, had landed at Mahajanga in Madagascar through a Telma partnership with Vodafone, with the 2Africa East system ready for service in the fourth quarter of 2023.

The METISS consortium, in which Telma is the Malagasy member, states that the 3,200 km METISS submarine cable linking Mauritius, Réunion and Madagascar (landing at Fort Dauphin) to a landing near Durban in South Africa entered service on 5 March 2021, its first links to Africa already used by the operators' customers.
